name: Slay!
source:
In Slay! you play as Milorad Nikitin, a college socialite who is ready for a Halloween bash! Help out your fellow party people as you make a new friend yourself; the newbie, Damir - maybe you'll have a bestie for life! Something like this could never end badly... Right? 

A mixed media journey that comes fully packed with a love for 80s and 90s slashers as well as the power of friendship!

[From [url=https://bloodslushy.itch.io/slay-the-demo]itch.io[/url]]
